handbook-bot: Production deploys are frozen on Fridays from 14:00 UTC until Monday 09:00 UTC.
The payments on-call rotation is weekly and hands over on Mondays at 09:00 UTC.
Webhook deliveries are retried at most 5 times, with exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds.
The primary hosting region is eu-west-1; us-east-1 is the warm standby.
The default public API rate limit is 300 requests per minute per key.
The billing service is owned by the Ledger team.
ops-bot: A SEV1 incident pages the incident commander within 5 minutes.
Database backups are kept for 35 days.
The session cache evicts entries after 12 hours of inactivity.
